notes:
Summary: Mid-market revenue ops platform focused on outbound SDR + account-based playbooks. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API as quick path; trial then compare to Dedicated for predictable latency/cost. Primary ask: low-latency streaming + tool-calling (CRM writebacks, send email, create calendar events) for live agent UI.

Key people: VP Product (Kayla Morris) driving roadmap for AI agents; Head of Engineering (Luis Ortega) owns infra/security; AE: Jordan Lee (Redwood); SE: Priya Raman (Redwood).

From discovery call (2026-01-21): "If streaming takes >200ms per partial chunk the UI will feel laggy — we need sub-250ms partials for 256-token windows." Interested in function/tool calling patterns for: create_contact, update_deal_stage, send_sequence_email, schedule_demo. Wants example SDK patterns for streaming + tool calls.

Security & compliance: SOC2 in progress; require SSO (SAML), audit logs forwarded to Splunk, KMS integration for customer keys, and soft data residency controls (US-only). Legal asked for encryption-in-transit + at-rest diagrams.

Commercial: Starting POC on Hosted API (30-day pilot, capped QPS), then two-week Dedicated performance run to validate tail latency and throughput. Price sensitive on token cost at scale; total cost target ~$120k ARR equivalent.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- 95th pct token latency < 350ms for streaming UI (256 token window)
- Successful function/tool call end-to-end < 500ms (CRM write + webhook confirmation)
- No dropped streams under normal concurrency (up to 30 concurrent agents)
- Audit log visibility and KMS key rotation documented

Notes from demo (2026-02-08): Showed streaming SDK + example tool-caller middleware. Kayla: "Need to show actual UI latency not just server numbers." Luis: "We'll require network topology for VPC peering if Dedicated."

Risks: heavy reliance on low tail latency; if fallback to smaller models increases hallucination risk for tool calls. Also concerned about routing/fallback path when Dedicated capacity saturated.

Quoted quotes: "If we can't get consistent streaming latency at 95th, we can't ship agent UI" — Kayla.

CRM fragments and stubs: Fireflies call ff-2026-01-21-msc-8421 (prod requirements); Gmail thread r-threads/CA+POC+maplewood+2026 contains pricing back-and-forth; Drive pricing-deck-v2.pdf attached. Jira security ticket RW-1342 opened for KMS question.
